page.layout: One printed page, one text column; no margin notes. Running head at top, page number at top left. Text runs from a catchword-less column to the foot.

main_text.p: §. 5. Omnes enumeratæ partes porro multum inter se differunt ratione unitatis vel multiplicitatis, hujusque determinatæ vel indeterminatæ, magnitudinis figuræ, situs, connexionis, porro ratione qualitatum sensibilium & insensibilium ut temperamenti, qualitatum secundarum secundarum, gravitatis & levitatis, qualitatum occultarum, coloris, odoris, saporis. Has omnes prolixum foret perfequi, egregiam vero hic operam præstitit Doctissimus Spigel. l.1.fuæ introduct. c. 8. & seqq. qui videri poteft.
main_text.head: CAPUT III.
De summis plantarum generibus.
main_text.p: I. Nsignis plantarum varietas est, quæ tamen omnes secundum perfectionis ordinem ad fungos & tubera terræ, herbas, cremia, frutices, & arbores revocantur: ita ut hæc summa genera postea ulterius minutius dividantur.

§. Summa plantarum genera alii aliter recensent, quippe alii quinque numerant, quemadmodum nos, quod non improbat Spigel. l.1.c.14. quidam quatuor omissis vel tuberibus & fungis: vel frutice & cremio seu suffrutice sub uno gene-

page.notes: Catchword "gene-" is a hyphenated line-end word at the foot, not a separate catchword. Passage in §.5 reads as printed; "secundarum secundarum" and "egregiam" are printed as shown. Some words at line ends are partly worn; the transcription follows the visible letters.
